title: Billing
communityIntro: Free: unlimited meetings and people, every facilitation module. Team adds the AI assistant, transcripts, workflows, tickets, calendars, video links, your logo and insights by email.
teamIntro: Every Team feature for the whole workspace. You pay for the people who took part in a meeting in the last 30 days; the seats follow them every day.
